decisions.quote:
Based on the above, we summarize this replication as partly successful. We discuss

potential reasons for the discrepancies between the original results and ours and their implications

in the general discussion.
decisions.reason: In Study 2 (replicating Experiment 1 of Connolly et al., 2013), the authors replicated the baseline decoy effect and the choice justifiability finding, found inconclusive/null results for regret salience and choice regret, and explicitly gave an overall verdict summarizing the replication as 'partly successful' (mixed). The shipped quote describes the low-reversibility extension rather than an uninformative verdict on the replication.

corrected_value.title: Seeking subjective dominance in multidimensional space: An explanation of the asymmetric dominance effect.

decisions.quote:
This article reports two very close replication studies of the decoy effect, targeting

Experiment 1 in Ariely and Wallsten (1995) and Experiment 1 in Connolly et al. (2013).
decisions.reason: In addition to replicating Connolly et al. (2013) in Study 2, the paper conducts a full direct replication of Experiment 1 from Ariely and Wallsten (1995) in Study 1 (reporting a failed replication outcome), making it an omitted replication target.
